reason: Tests only (#424): the fourteen fixed waits added since the review re-evaluation were audited — six kept with a comment (the elapsed time is what they check: a hold past the coalescing window, a screen that must stay open, nothing written while time passes), four replaced by the state they stood in for (a flushed autosave, two animation frames, the closed screen, a polled overlay state), four removed (they guarded nothing) — and licenses.spec's locale switch now waits in the page (waitForFunction, the same 8 s bound) instead of polling page.evaluate, after a CI trace showed a poll sample that never returned. Nothing in the app changes.
